columns.Gross Currency: The three-character ISO currency code for the transaction currency.
columns.Net Currency: The three-character ISO currency code for the settlement currency.
columns.Exchange Rate: The exchange rate used for converting the gross amount into the net amount. This will be 1 if you process and settle in the same currency.
columns.Creation Date: The timestamp indicating when the payment was created on the Adyen payments platform. Format: YYYY-MM-DD HH:MM:SS
columns.TimeZone: The time zone of the Creation Date.

notes: For externally settled payments the listed exchange rate is Adyen's reference exchange rate, not the actual rate applied by the external acquirer.

Checkout dccQuote (ForexQuote, https://github.com/Adyen/adyen-openapi json/CheckoutService-v71.json at e7986c7): buy, sell and interbank are Amount objects ({currency, value} in minor units) described only as 'The buy rate.', 'The sell rate.' and 'The interbank amount.'; basePoints is an int32 'The base points.'; validTill is a date-time. How they map to a rate is not documented, so no adapter is provided for them.
